bio: Welcome to Harvard! I grew up in the Seattle area, but have found myself on the east coast since leaving for college in Philadelphia. More recently, I graduated from the Harvard Kennedy School of Government concentrating in international and global affairs. I worked in international development in Nicaragua prior to HKS, and now work in higher education at the College. Outside of work, I love creating at the ceramics studio, traveling, and trying my hand at new recipes. I am so excited to meet the Class of 2029 and to support you in your first year of college!
